title: Strings by hand
description:
Write these in `solution.c` with loops over the characters, **without** `string.h`:

```c
size_t my_strlen(const char s[]);          /* characters before the '\0' */
int count_char(const char s[], char c);    /* how many times c appears */
void to_upper(char s[]);                   /* changes a to z into A to Z, in place */
int is_palindrome(const char s[]);         /* 1 if s reads the same backwards ("level"), else 0; "" is one */
```
hints: Every function walks the string until `s[i] == '\0'`. `my_strlen` just counts how many steps that takes.
For upper case, subtract `'a' - 'A'` from each lower-case letter. For the palindrome, compare `s[i]` with `s[length - 1 - i]` for the first half.
rules: Write the loops yourself, without string.h.
